Which kinds of municipal zone exist in Colombia, judged by drinking-water quality, services
and context, and how do health and education outcomes differ between them?

- 🔍 [Explore](explore.qmd) the data · 🧩 [Clusters](clusters.qmd) and how they were chosen
- 📄 [Report](report.qmd) (also Word and PDF) · 📊 [Council slides](slides.pptx) ·
  📗 [Tables](tables.qmd) (Excel) · 📈 [Dashboard](dashboard.qmd)

One `scripts/analysis.py` computes every result once and writes `outputs/`; every page
reads those files. IRCA is the **utility-supplied ("prestadores") IRCA** in INS open data
(datos.gov.co `nxt2-39c3`). Comparisons are descriptive and do not establish a causal
effect of water quality.
